verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's own docs show work fanned across many items. A scheduled skill runs "against the current account list" (docs-31). Bots run in parallel (docs-3) and can be duplicated per scope, e.g. one per region (docs-22). A month-long user reports one bot contacting about 40 suppliers in a single effort (comm-5). However, these are agent-driven loops rather than a documented bulk-operation feature with defined scope, batching or per-item results. missing for 10: an explicit documented bulk/batch operation capability (select many items and act at once), documentation of per-item status or rollback for batch runs, a programmatic surface for batch jobs (no Grok Bot API/CLI per probe-rt-2).
